# Webliix

> Webliix is an MSME-registered full-service digital agency and software engineering company. Webliix designs, develops, and deploys high-performance business websites, Shopify e-commerce stores, custom SaaS applications, cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), Google Business Profile (GMB) optimization, and technical SEO for businesses worldwide.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Custom Website Development](https://webliix.com/website-development): Responsive corporate websites, landing pages, and modern React 19 / Next.js web applications built for speed, conversion, and 100% client code ownership.
- [Shopify E-Commerce Stores](https://webliix.com/ecommerce-store): Custom Shopify store setup, bespoke theme development, payment gateway integration, product SEO, and checkout optimization.
- [SEO & Google Business Profile](https://webliix.com/seo): Technical SEO audits, on-page optimization, Google Business Profile (GMB) verification and local Maps 3-Pack ranking.
- [Custom Web Applications & SaaS](https://webliix.com/web-app-development): Scalable SaaS systems, customer portals, internal CRM/ERP dashboards, and secure REST APIs built with Java Spring Boot and React.
- [Mobile App Development](https://webliix.com/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android mobile applications built with Flutter and React Native.
- [Branding & UI/UX Design](https://webliix.com/branding-design): Corporate visual identity, vector logo design, brand guidelines, and high-fidelity Figma design systems.
- [Website Maintenance & Support](https://webliix.com/website-maintenance): 24/7 uptime monitoring, security patching, cloud backups, and on-demand developer support.
- [Paid Advertising & Performance Marketing](https://webliix.com/paid-advertising): High-ROI performance marketing across Google Ads PPC and Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  - [Google Ads Management](https://webliix.com/google-ads): High-intent Search, Performance Max, and Local Services PPC.
  - [Meta Ads Management](https://webliix.com/meta-ads): Lookalike audience targeting, ad creatives, and conversion retargeting.
- [Webliix LaunchKit](https://webliix.com/launch-kit): All-in-one 5-day business launch package (Website + Logo + Google Business Profile + Local SEO) starting at ₹9,999 ($149).
